name: powershell-conventions
description: Always-on PowerShell correctness rules: wrap any call to a function returning a variable-count collection in @() at every call site, never embed a literal backslash inside a joined path string meant to run cross-platform, quote literal @-prefixed string arguments, and use New-Item -ItemType SymbolicLink instead of ln -s on Windows.

origin.note: Distilled from two 2026-07 incident notes captured during ai-toolkit/es-ai-toolkit baseline.ps1 status-command work: an array-unwrap bug masked by pwsh 7's synthetic scalar .Count convenience (only surfaced when tested under real Windows PowerShell 5.1), and a literal-backslash-in-path bug that silently breaks Join-Path calls under macOS/Linux pwsh.
origin.relationship: Principles 5-6 added 2026-09 identically to both ai-toolkit and es-ai-toolkit — general git-bash/shell tooling facts, not employer-specific.
